name: Mitsui Takumi
source:
Mitsui Takumi (affectionally called "Taku-chan" by [url=http://vndb.org/c2111]Yuuki[/url]) is in the advanced science and mathematics division at Souryou, and he lives on campus in the dorms. His grandfather, father, and older brother are all doctors, so he studies to become a doctor as well. He is very tech-savvy and enjoys online gaming and fancy cell phones. He also enjoys playing tennis, listening to classical music, and has a great appreciation for coffee. 

Voiced by Suzuki Chihiro.

[From [url=http://blgames.ukepile.com/database/snow/snow.php]Boys' Love Games Headquarters[/url]]
